import subprocess

def run_ledger(input_data, args):
    process = subprocess.Popen(
        ['python3', 'src/ledger.py'] + args,
        stdin=subprocess.PIPE,
        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
        text=True
    )
    stdout, stderr = process.communicate(input=input_data)
    return process.returncode, stdout, stderr

records = """2026-01-05,food,10.00
2026-02-03,food,5.005
2026-01-20,rent,800
"""

# Test total
code, out, err = run_ledger(records, ['total'])
print(f"Total: {out.strip()} (Code: {code})")
assert out.strip() == "815.01"

# Test categories
code, out, err = run_ledger(records, ['categories'])
print(f"Categories:\n{out.strip()}")
expected_categories = "rent: 800.00\nfood: 15.01"
assert out.strip() == expected_categories

# Test category food
code, out, err = run_ledger(records, ['category', 'food'])
print(f"Category food: {out.strip()} (Code: {code})")
assert out.strip() == "15.01"

# Test category travel (should fail)
code, out, err = run_ledger(records, ['category', 'travel'])
print(f"Category travel: {out.strip()} (Code: {code})")
assert code == 1

# Test malformed line
code, out, err = run_ledger("2026-01-05,food\n", ['total'])
print(f"Malformed line: {err.strip()} (Code: {code})")
assert code == 2

print("All tests passed!")
